about: Accepted disagreements of the engine's damage rolls, damage()'s and gen4Damage's on real Pokémon (test/real/engineVsCalcDamage.test.ts), keyed '<attacker> <move> <defender>' with the reason. The 2026-11-09 sweep (11 eligible Pokémon of the frozen 12 June save against the 1,771 enemy Pokémon pairs of the first 40 single-battle trainers, 8,974 move comparisons, plain and critical) has none: every move gen4Damage derives agrees three ways. The 714 moves it does not derive (power from weight, speed, PP or the hit number; Bide, Counter, Mirror Coat, Metal Burst, the one-hit KO moves, Future Sight, Psywave, Beat Up) are counted, not compared. The 2026-11-12 sweep of the player's current save (pk-run-2026-11-11: 15 eligible Pokémon, 2,415 pairs, 13,818 comparisons, 637 not derived) has none either: its 109 first-run disagreements were Raticate's Endeavor on a foe with less HP than its own, which fails (effect_script_0189.s:7, :14; the gen4 mod's onTry) where the sweep had called getDamage without the move's Try (task X2).
